title: Low-frequency S0 Lamb wave in a free plate: plate velocity (analytic)
description:
A 0.275 mm solid plate (11 cells of 25 um, nu = 1/3: cL = 2 cS = 6000 m/s, rho 2700) between vacuum cells (traction-free faces), 125 mm long with 120-cell absorbing layers on both x faces (rigid y faces behind the vacuum, never reached). A normal traction sheet across the plate (Ricker 0.5 MHz, wavelength ~10 mm = 38 plate thicknesses) launches the symmetric Lamb mode S0 both ways (~2 s per run).
Analytic (thin plate, plane strain, f d << cS): S0 travels at the plate velocity c_p = sqrt(E / (rho (1 - nu^2))) = 2 cS sqrt(1 - cS^2 / cL^2) = sqrt(3) cS = 5196 m/s, not at cL = 6000 m/s (the plate contracts laterally), with the thickness-averaged velocity v_x = T / (2 rho c_p) s(t - |x - x_s| / c_p) on each side (s the Ricker wavelet, peak 1 at t0 = 4 / f0). Dispersion corrections ~ (nu / (1 - nu))^2 (k d / 2)^2 / 6 ~ 3e-4 at f0 (the curves use the non-dispersive pulse).
Derived values tab: m1_matched / m2_matched = matched filters (v_x at the plate midplane projected on the Ricker wavelet at the predicted S0 arrival, over its energy) at 20 and 50 mm from the sheet: 1 expected (tolerance 2 %); at cL the pulse would arrive 0.5 / 1.3 us early (pi f0 times the shift = 0.8 / 2) and both filters would fall far below 1.
Probes tab: probe_1 / probe_2 (v_x at the midplane) with the dashed S0 pulses.
Line profile tab: vx_midplane along the midplane at the final time (pulse centre ~88 mm) vs the S0 pulse (tolerance 3 % of the range; dispersion and the O((k d)^2) mode-shape corrections expected below 1 %).

parameters.name: f0
parameters.description: Ricker peak frequency

parameters.name: t0_r
parameters.description: time of the Ricker maximum at the sheet (8 us)

parameters.name: T_sheet
parameters.description: peak traction of the sheet in Pa

parameters.name: rho_s
parameters.description: plate density in kg/m^3

parameters.name: cS_s
parameters.description: shear speed in m/s

parameters.name: cL_s
parameters.description: longitudinal speed in m/s (cL = 2 cS: nu = 1/3)

parameters.name: c_plate
parameters.description: S0 plate velocity in m/s (sqrt(3) cS = 5196)

parameters.name: v0
parameters.description: S0 velocity amplitude on each side in m/s

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: N_cells
parameters.description: plate cells across y (odd: the midplane is a cell centre)

parameters.name: d_plate
parameters.description: plate thickness (free faces on cell edges)

parameters.name: y0_plate
parameters.description: lower plate face (two vacuum cells below it)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: domain height: plate plus two vacuum cells each side

parameters.name: y_mid
parameters.description: plate midplane (a cell centre)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: plate length (5000 cells)

parameters.name: n_pml
parameters.description: absorbing layer cells on each x face (3 mm)

parameters.name: x_s
parameters.description: sheet position (cell centre, 15.0 mm; its normal traction sits on the two x faces of the cell)

parameters.name: r1
parameters.description: distance sheet -> v_x node of probe_1 (its cell's +x face, 20.0 mm)

parameters.name: r2
parameters.description: distance sheet -> v_x node of probe_2 (50.0 mm)

parameters.name: t1
parameters.description: S0 pulse centre time at probe_1

parameters.name: t2
parameters.description: S0 pulse centre time at probe_2

parameters.name: E_ric
parameters.description: Ricker energy: integral of s^2 dt in s

parameters.name: S_courant
parameters.description: courant setting

parameters.name: dt_ac
parameters.description: acoustic step: courant / (sqrt(2 c11 / rho) sqrt(2) / dx), the solid-vacuum faces having rho / 2

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration (probe_2's window ends at t2 + 2 / f0 = 21.6 us)

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: final time: the tick nearest T_run

parameters.name: t_vel
parameters.description: time of the final velocities (half a step before t_end)

analytic_curves.name: vx_midplane
analytic_curves.expression: v0*(1 - 2*(pi*f0*(t_vel - t0_r - (x + dx_cell/2 - x_s)/c_plate))**2)*exp(-(pi*f0*(t_vel - t0_r - (x + dx_cell/2 - x_s)/c_plate))**2)
